title: B2B & International Marketing Manager
company: Axon Moore Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Warrington - Hybrid
Salary: Up to £45,000 + bonus

Axon Moore is currently partnered with an established product-led business in Warrington who are going through a really exciting period of change within their marketing function.

They're building out the team and are looking for a B2 B & International Marketing Manager to take ownership of their B2 B marketing activity across the UK, whilst also helping shape how campaigns and activity are adapted across international markets.

This is a role where you'll genuinely have the opportunity to make it your own. There are processes in place, but they're looking for someone who will bring fresh ideas, challenge how things are currently done and take real ownership of their marketing stream.

What will you be doing?

You'll take the lead on the B2 B marketing strategy, working closely with Sales, Product, Commercial and Technical teams to understand what the business needs and turn this into effective marketing activity.

You'll be involved across the full marketing lifecycle, including:
- Owning the B2 B marketing plan, budget and campaign calendar
- Developing campaigns for wholesalers, distributors, contractors, installers and channel partners
- Supporting product launches and go-to-market activity
- Creating propositions, messaging and sales enablement materials
- Working with international teams to develop campaigns that can be adapted across different markets
- Managing external agencies across PR, content, digital and campaigns
- Taking briefs from internal teams and turning them into clear, commercially focused campaigns
- Managing agency relationships, budgets, deadlines and performance
- Working closely with Sales and Product to make sure marketing is commercially relevant
- Supporting and developing the International Marketing Coordinator/Executive

You'll have plenty of autonomy, so we're looking for someone who is happy to take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do. You'll have the opportunity to look at what's currently in place, identify where things could be improved and put your own stamp on the function.

What are they looking for?

You'll ideally have a strong background in B2 B marketing, particularly within a product, channel, distribution or manufacturing-led environment.

Experience within sectors such as construction, building products, manufacturing, engineering, electrical, industrial, wholesale or distribution would be particularly relevant, but we're open to other product-led B2 B backgrounds.

What is important is that you understand B2 B customers and channels and have experience working with things like:
- Wholesalers, distributors, contractors or installers
- Product and proposition marketing
- Integrated marketing campaigns
- Agency management and briefing
- Go-to-market activity
- Budgets and campaign performance
- International markets or adapting campaigns across different countries

You'll need to be hands-on, commercially minded and comfortable working across lots of different projects at once. Just as importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys getting to know people, building relationships across the business and bringing a positive, fresh approach.

The business

This is a brilliant time to join. The marketing function is being developed and there is a real opportunity to help shape how the team operates going forward.

What's on offer?
- £35,000-£45,000 salary
- Flexibility around salary for the right person
- Monthly bonus of up to £300 based on company performance
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the Warrington office / 2 from home
- 20 days' holiday, increasing with length of service
- Office closure over Christmas, which doesn't come out of your holiday allowance
- A genuinely autonomous role where you can make your mark

If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, bring new ideas and have a real influence on the direction of B2 B marketing, I'd love to hear from you.

INDBSO

title: B2C & Retail Marketing Manager
company: Axon Moore Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Warrington - Hybrid
Salary up to £45,000 plus bonus

I'm working with an established consumer-focused, product-led business in Warrington who are currently building out their marketing function, and they're looking for a B2 C & Retail Marketing Manager to take ownership of one of their key consumer brands.

This is a really exciting opportunity for someone who wants more than just another Marketing Manager role. You'll have real autonomy, plenty of scope to bring new ideas and the opportunity to shape how B2 C marketing develops within the business.

There are processes and agency relationships already in place, but they want someone who will come in, take ownership and look at how things can be done better.

What will you be doing?

You'll own the B2 C marketing strategy, working closely with the commercial, product and retail teams to make sure marketing activity is both creative and commercially effective.

Your role will include:
- Owning the annual B2 C marketing plan, budget and campaign calendar
- Developing campaigns around new products, seasonal activity and retail promotions
- Working closely with retail account teams and customers
- Improving product listings, digital shelf content, imagery, reviews and conversion
- Developing activity across social media, influencers, paid media, email and content
- Managing external agencies across creative, PR, social, content and paid media
- Briefing agencies and managing campaigns from initial idea through to delivery
- Managing budgets, timelines and campaign performance
- Working closely with Product, Commercial, Technical, Sales and Customer Services teams
- Making sure all customer-facing content is accurate, relevant and commercially focused

A big part of the role will be managing relationships with key retail customers, so you'll need to be comfortable working with large retail accounts and understanding the pace and demands that come with them.

What are they looking for?

The key thing here is retail and consumer marketing experience.

You'll ideally have worked within a B2 C, retail, ecommerce or consumer-focused, product-led environment and be comfortable turning customer insight and commercial priorities into campaigns that deliver.

You'll ideally have experience across:
- Retail marketing
- Consumer/B2 C marketing
- Ecommerce and digital content
- Product launches and campaigns
- Agency management and briefing
- Social, content, paid media or influencer activity
- Working with retail customers
- Campaign performance and analytics

Experience within home improvement, consumer products, ecommerce, DIY, electrical, interiors or another retailer-led category would be a bonus, but isn't essential.

You'll need to be creative and full of ideas, but also commercially minded and comfortable getting into the detail. This is a hands-on role, so they're looking for someone who enjoys actually doing the work rather than simply managing a team who do it for them.

The business

This is a particularly exciting time to join as they're building out their marketing function and looking for people who want to help shape it.

You'll have the freedom to look at what's currently in place, bring your own ideas and make improvements rather than simply stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone.

The culture is friendly and personable, with a real family feel, but you'll also have the structure and backing of a larger international organisation.

What's on offer?
- £35,000-£45,000 salary
- Flexibility around salary for the right person
- Monthly bonus of up to £300 based on company performance
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the Warrington office / 2 from home
- 20 days' holiday, increasing with length of service
- Office closure over Christmas, which doesn't come out of your holiday allowance
- Lots of autonomy and the opportunity to make the role your own

If you're a retail/B2 C marketer who wants to bring new ideas, take ownership and genuinely help shape a growing marketing function, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Communications and Media Relations Manager
description:
About us

There has never been a more exciting time to work in renewable energy, and the MCS Group has big ambitions. Our aim is to ensure every UK home benefits from being carbon free, by transforming the way our homes are heated, cooled and powered and giving everyone confidence in home-grown energy. With energy costs rising and climate change affecting us all, low-carbon technology has a big role to play in the future of UK energy.

The MCS Group is comprised of The MCS Foundation, a charitable foundation, and MCS (Microgeneration Certification Scheme), the UK's quality mark for renewable energy technologies like solar panels and heat pumps. The Scheme sets standards for installations and products and protects consumers. The MCS Scheme currently certifies over 5,400 installers, 369,000 installations a year and over 100,000 low carbon technology products to MCS Standards.

The MCS Foundation owns MCS as its only shareholder and advances the adoption of low carbon solutions through research, advocacy, grants and action-oriented programmes.

Our dynamic communications and marketing teams are integral to our success, responsible for managing media relations, organising impactful industry, stakeholder, and internal events, and overseeing our digital presence. They develop and execute communication plans and strategies that reinforce and our brands and our messages. At the heart of our business, they create compelling content, harnessing the power of our rich data to tell engaging stories that resonate with our diverse stakeholders.

Why you'll love working for MCS

Aside from an exciting and challenging role, the people, our culture, and our mission, we have some amazing benefits that make MCS a pretty great place to work. Here's a few favourites among our team:

Our Team: We are an energetic, sociable and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do, and we are determined to make a difference. We are friendly, supportive, collaborative and we learn from each other every day.

Holiday: 25 days' annual leave per annum (plus UK bank holidays) - increasing to 28 days with three years' service, and to 30 days with five years' service.

Social Events: Summer socials, Christmas party, regular events in the office, dress-down Fridays, and more.

Wellbeing: All employees have access to an Employee Assistance Programme, optional access to Medicash - a healthcare plan with the highest level of cover. Access to Mental Health First Aider, up to 8 counselling sessions, helping to ensure that every team member feels supported.

Supportive HR Policies: Enhanced Maternity, Paternity leave, sick leave, and emergency paid leave, life assurance 5 x your salary.

Grow with MCS: Access to and support with continuous professional development.

Professional Membership: Funding for one annual professional membership aligned to your role or professional discipline.

New Starters: Welcome lunch with the Managing Director.

Company Pension: 8% company contribution.

Working week: 37.5 hours Monday - Friday with flexible working options.

Salary Sacrifice Schemes: Cycle to work and additional annual leave purchase - subject to individual eligibility criteria.

Free Parking: when working from the Daresbury office.

EV charging facilities: when working from the Daresbury office.

About the role

You will be an important part of the strategic communications and media relations team, managing the development of integrated communications campaign plans, media and stakeholder engagement activity.

What you'll do

Responsible for developing and delivering integrated communications campaigns, in line with organisational priorities and objectives, ensuring all activity is well coordinated.

Work closely with digital communications and events teams to build multi-disciplinary campaigns and plans, leveraging a mix of skills and expertise to ensure the right channels and tactics are used to reach target audiences.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders and functional teams, working as part of larger project teams to drive forward organisational objectives.

Develop compelling messaging and narratives, tailored to a wide range of audiences across two brands.

Support the development of consistent communications across a range of external stakeholders (e.g. government, trade associations, businesses, manufacturers).

Build and maintain relationships with partner communication teams, maximising opportunities for collaboration and to mitigate risk.

Support the development and delivery of our media strategy, maximising opportunities and increase media coverage for both MCS and The MCS Foundation.

Grow our media contacts, building strong relationships with key journalists across print, online and broadcast.

Provide support to Senior Leadership Team on events, media, messaging and communications best practice.

Provide trusted communications advice and guidance to the Senior Leadership Team during fast-moving, sensitive or high-profile situations.

Secure proactive media profiling and speaking opportunities for CEO, Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team.

The ability to work calmly, exercise sound judgement and respond effectively in a fast-moving environment.

Support the develop and implementation of crisis communication strategies to protect and enhance the reputation of MCS Group, ensuring timely and effective responses to emerging issues, media enquiries and stakeholder concerns.

What we're looking for

Substantial communications experience gained within a commercial or non-profit environment, with a demonstrable track record of developing and delivering integrated communications campaigns. An understanding of or interest in the UK energy landscape or environmental issues.

Demonstrable experience working with UK media and a strong understanding of the UK press landscape.

Experience translating organisational objectives into compelling and structured key messages for complex audiences.

Excellent communicator with strong verbal, writing and interpersonal skills.

Have exceptional organisational skills and an ability to juggle multiple workstreams and to prioritise and deliver accordingly.

Creative, and able to motivate teams to develop ambitious, innovative, impactful plans.

Understanding of project management and capable of managing matrix-managing multi-disciplinary plans.

Confidence managing multiple priorities, projects and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

title: Presenter and Content Creator
description:
Our client, a fast-growing marketing agency based in Warrington, are looking for an outgoing and enthusiastic Presenter and Content Creator to join their busy team! This is a full-time, permanent role, and is office based. Our client has two positions available for this role!

Benefits:
- Salary - £26,000 to £30,000 per annum, dependant on experience
- Monthly bonus incentives
- Working Hours - Monday to Friday, with 3 days of 9am to 5pm, and 2 days of 1pm to 10pm
- Holidays - 28 days Including Bank Holidays
- Access to the latest live streaming and production equipment!
- The chance to work with some of the top, industry-leading beauty and lifestyle brands

The Role:

Within this unique role, the successful candidate/s will be responsible for hosting TikTok live shopping events with the aim of successfully selling a range of different products to viewers. They will also be responsible for the production of these live events, managing the livestream set ups and ensuring the broadcasts run smoothly!

Day-to-Day of the Role:
- Present live shopping events on TikTok and other platforms, showcasing different products to live audiences
- Build rapport with the audience, answer questions as they come in and drive engagement about products
- Create content for top brands for different products
- Assist in the production of livestream events (full training will be provided!)
- Stay up to date with the latest product trends across TikTok and other platforms

What We're Looking For:
- A confident and outgoing individual, who will be comfortable showcasing products on camera!
- A strong communicator, with the ability to multi-task
- A passion for beauty and lifestyle products
- A background in digital marketing and content creation is preferred, however is by no means essential
- A willingness to learn about live event production, including the use of the latest live streaming production equipment

Please apply today if this role is right for you!

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager

Warrington Hybrid Working 35,000- 40,000 + Bonus

A growing digital marketing agency is looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager to join their team and take ownership of paid media campaigns across Meta and Google Ads.

Working with a diverse client portfolio spanning financial services, events and consumer brands, you'll be responsible for driving performance, optimising campaigns and delivering measurable commercial results.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on role where you'll manage campaigns from strategy through to execution, reporting and optimisation. You'll work closely with both clients and creative teams to identify opportunities for growth and maximise campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise paid campaigns across Meta and Google Ads
- Deliver strong performance against CPA, CPL and ROAS targets
- Analyse campaign data and implement ongoing improvements
- Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad creative
- Present campaign results and recommendations to clients
- Oversee tracking, attribution and conversion measurement
- Identify new opportunities to drive growth across client accounts

About You
- 3+ years' experience in Paid Social and/or PPC
- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads
- Experience using GA4 and conversion tracking tools
- Commercially focused with a data-driven mindset
- Confident communicating with clients and stakeholders
- Able to demonstrate successful campaign results

Desirable Experience
- Lead generation campaigns
- Financial services or regulated sectors
- Landing page optimisation and CRO
- TikTok Ads

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 35,000- 40,000 DOE
- Performance-related bonus
- Hybrid working
- Flexible working arrangements
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Pension scheme
- Clear progression path within a growing business
